newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain unions say labour reform talks going badly.
newsitem.headline: Spain unions say labour reform talks going badly.

text.p: Negotiations between trade unions and employers on the reform of Spain's labour market are not making progress, union leaders said on Wednesday.

"I have to say that negotiations are going badly...employers are still thinking in terms of the temporary and the precarious," said Antonio Gutierrez, head of CCOO trade union, speaking at an employment seminar organised by the Labour Ministry.
A survey published recently by the Labour Ministry found that more that 96 percent of jobs created in 1996 were temporary, and around 70 percent of contracts had durations of less than three months.
The government has said that if an agreement is not reached between the two parties, it is prepared to step in and resolve the issue.
